Text.Text: The forced rhythm is broken. Let your beast set a pace with you, never under you. You've finished my Alpha Rhythm trials. I have no further work for you here.
These trials need rank 50 in Beast Mastery. Keep training as a handler, then return. The pack needs a lead it can trust.

Handlers in the preserve are forcing their beasts into a killing rhythm. The hunt tally will tell me where they started. Defeat six Alpha Rhythm Adepts in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Alpha Rhythm Tarn Hunt Tally; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins. I'll give you the Dathomir Tarn Jungle Preserve Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Alpha Rhythm.

Here's the Dathomir Tarn Jungle Preserve Key. Use 'Tarn Jungle Preserve' in Dathomir, Tarnished Jungles. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Alpha Rhythm Adepts, then return with the Alpha Rhythm Tarn Hunt Tally.

A forced lead sets a rhythm the whole line has to follow whether it wants to or not. Adepts goad a beast into that position instead of letting one earn it. Sounds close to a real pack rhythm if you don't know better. It isn't. It's just noise wearing a beat's shape.
A true lead doesn't force tempo. It offers one, and the pack chooses to follow because the choice keeps everyone alive together. That's rhythm. Command without choice is just noise with good timing.

Every true count this preserve ever kept got scratched onto that tally, generation over generation. Adepts use it to fake a rhythm they never earned. Bring it back and the true count's mine to read again, not theirs to counterfeit.
Defeat six Alpha Rhythm Adepts in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Alpha Rhythm Tarn Hunt Tally; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins.
You've defeated six Alpha Rhythm Adepts. Let me see the Alpha Rhythm Tarn Hunt Tally.
That's the record I needed. We can account for the trails again. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists use scent to keep that forced rhythm going. Bring back their vial so I can study it. Defeat five Alpha Rhythm Specialists in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Alpha Rhythm Beast-Pen Scent Vial; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Defeat five Alpha Rhythm Specialists to secure the Alpha Rhythm Beast-Pen Scent Vial, then return to me.

Dosed to force a tempo through scent alone, no choosing involved anywhere in it. Bring that vial back and I've got the forced beat isolated, proof of exactly how they've been playing this preserve like an instrument that never agreed to be played.

Earning a beat takes patience. Forcing one takes a vial and no conscience. They chose the vial because it's faster, and because a pack that's forced doesn't ask questions about who's leading it. Efficient. Also completely dishonest.

No. A pack under a forced tempo isn't moving together, it's just moving at the same time, which sounds the same for about a beat and a half before it falls apart. True rhythm holds because every player in it is choosing the same beat freely. Force it, and the first missed step brings the whole line down.
Defeat five Alpha Rhythm Specialists in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Alpha Rhythm Beast-Pen Scent Vial; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins.
You've defeated five Alpha Rhythm Specialists. Let me see the Alpha Rhythm Beast-Pen Scent Vial.
This belongs with the handlers who know how to use it. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden holds the preserve's alpha totem. We need it back before the old pack order can be restored. Defeat the Alpha Rhythm Warden in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Alpha Rhythm Clawed Alpha Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Alpha Rhythm Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Alpha Rhythm Clawed Alpha Totem.

Fast, relentless, alone. He set that tempo himself once, honestly, before the crew got their hands on him and taught him to force it onto anyone standing near. Half the man I remember is still in that beat somewhere. The other half is exactly why you need company.

Alpha totem marks the true lead of a pack line, the one every follower chose freely. He's carrying it clawed apart because he stopped being a true lead the day he started forcing his beat instead of earning it. Bring it back whole and the true lead is honored again.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Alpha Rhythm Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Alpha Rhythm Warden in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Alpha Rhythm Clawed Alpha Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Alpha Rhythm Warden. Let me see the Alpha Rhythm Clawed Alpha Totem.
The totem is back in our keeping. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The four keepers made this abuse into a training method. Take their token and end their control of the preserve. Defeat four members of the Alpha Rhythm Inner Circle in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Alpha Rhythm Preserve Keeper's Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Defeat four members of the Alpha Rhythm Inner Circle to secure the Alpha Rhythm Preserve Keeper's Token, then return to me.

Force instead of earn, drum instead of offer, and they wrote it all down and taught it like scripture to anyone who'd listen. A pack built on that never actually moves together. It just moves at the same time, right up until it doesn't, and then it's four soloists standing where a pack used to be.

That token's the true count of who's allowed to call tempo for this whole preserve. They minted false copies to cover for each other. One real token in my hands, and every false beat they've called since gets silenced with it.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Alpha Rhythm Inner Circle fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat four members of the Alpha Rhythm Inner Circle in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Alpha Rhythm Preserve Keeper's Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins.
You've defeated four members of the Alpha Rhythm Inner Circle. Let me see the Alpha Rhythm Preserve Keeper's Token.
The keepers can no longer claim authority here. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master sets the rhythm the others follow. Defeat him to finish the trial and let the pack choose its own lead. Defeat the Alpha Rhythm Master in Dathomir, Alpha Beast Hollow. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Alpha Beast Hollow, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Alpha Rhythm Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Because it's not a lie built from nothing. It's the true rhythm, the one I've spent my life teaching, bent just enough that it still sounds honest while it forces everyone near it to follow. You've been learning to offer a beat and let a pack choose it freely. He learned the same beat and decided choosing was optional. That's the whole difference, and it's the whole danger.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Alpha Rhythm Master fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Goes back to true tempo, offered and chosen, the way a pack's supposed to move. I'll be listening for it every day after this, and the day it sounds honest again all the way through, I'll know you finished the job right.

Defeat the Alpha Rhythm Master in Dathomir, Alpha Beast Hollow. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Alpha Rhythm Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The forced rhythm is broken. Let your beast set a pace with you, never under you. You've earned the right to train Alpha Rhythm. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the beat.
I'll defeat six Alpha Rhythm Adepts.
What do you mean, a wrong beat?
How does a lead beast set tempo for a pack?
What's this tally to your rhythm?
Let me listen a while longer.
Here's the Alpha Rhythm Tarn Hunt Tally.
Back to the beat.
I'll defeat five Alpha Rhythm Specialists.
What's the vial doing to the tempo?
Why force a beat instead of earning one?
Can a pack even move honestly under a forced tempo?
Give me a little more time.
Here's the Alpha Rhythm Beast-Pen Scent Vial.
Back to the beat.
I'll defeat the Alpha Rhythm Warden.
What's his rhythm like, exactly?
What does the alpha totem mean in your rhythm-language?
Would you recommend bringing help?
My pack isn't gathered yet.
Here's the Alpha Rhythm Clawed Alpha Totem.
Back to the beat.
I'll defeat four members of the Alpha Rhythm Inner Circle.
What did they turn into doctrine?
What does the keeper's token mean to your rhythm?
Would you recommend bringing help?
My pack needs rest first.
Here's the Alpha Rhythm Preserve Keeper's Token.
Back to the beat.
I'll face the Alpha Rhythm Master and report back.
What makes his rhythm so seductive?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What happens to the preserve's rhythm, once he's gone?
Not until every player's ready.
The Alpha Rhythm Master is defeated. Here's my report.
